Description:
[center][img]https://storage.ko-fi.com/cdn/useruploads/69f6abcf-4019-467f-b898-482e074b20b2_bge-14-v5-kitsuwick.gif[/img]

[size=6][b][color=#aaf0f4]🦇 Vampire Masquerade 🦇[/color][/b][/size]
[size=3][i]garnet velvet, warm walnut and ivory masks… an invitation to stay a little past midnight ✨[/i][/size][/center]

Hi hi! 💜 Dress your farmhouse for an evening masquerade with [b]44 furnishings[/b], plus [b]3 wallpapers and 3 floors[/b]. Cozy velvet seats, a sleepy double bed, candlelight and a little theatrical charm, indoors and out. Find the pieces at [b]Robin's[/b] 🪵💜

[center][img]https://storage.ko-fi.com/cdn/useruploads/display/3ac7f2f4-aa0b-42fe-abee-700c3d789afe_4d1cd0ff408a21be-compatible.gif[/img][/center]

[size=4][b]🧺 What's inside[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]🛏️ A real double bed, usable seating and table surfaces, and a clothing dresser.[/*]
[*]🕯️ Candle lamps, wall lights, evening windows and a crimson batwing hearth.[/*]
[*]🍷 A matching counter, prep island and display cupboard for decorating your kitchen.[/*]
[*]🦇 Mirrors, masks, rugs, a dressing screen, bookcases and a leafy night fern.[/*]
[*]⛲ An outdoor crimson fountain. This is a still ornamental piece, with no flowing liquid or refill function.[/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b]🍷 Optional: Farmhouse Kitchen Reskin[/b][/size]
Give the built-in stove, sink and cabinets a matching garnet-and-walnut look after the first farmhouse upgrade. The vanilla cooking menu still works, and your built-in fridge stays as it is. This standalone Content Patcher download works with either furniture edition, or on its own. Use one kitchen reskin at a time.

[size=4][b]📦 Updating an existing save?[/b][/size]
[b]If you use the old placeable Masquerade fridge, stove or sink, keep both original appliance folders or install Legacy Placeable Appliances before opening your save.[/b] Install one copy of each folder. Back up your save before updating.

[size=4][b]🏡 Optional: Vampire Masquerade House[/b][/size]
A separate matching farmhouse file, with warm ivory plaster, walnut framing and wine-colored roofs. [b]The decor works without the house.[/b] Three exterior appearances follow your farmhouse upgrades; upgrades 2 and 3 share the final manor. Includes winter snow and warm night windows. Install both included house folders.

[size=4][b]🛠️ Requirements & install[/b][/size]
For [b]Stardew Valley 1.6.15[/b], [b]SMAPI 4.5.2+[/b] and [b]Content Patcher 2.9.1+[/b]. Choose [b]one main file[/b]. The Furniture Framework version also needs [b]Furniture Framework 3.3+[/b]. Its wallpapers and floors still use Content Patcher.
[spoiler][list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI and the frameworks for your chosen main file.[/*]
[*]Choose the [b]Content Patcher[/b] or [b]Furniture Framework[/b] decor file, then extract every included folder into [b]Mods[/b].[/*]
[*]If you use the old placeable appliances, follow the update instructions above before loading your save.[/*]
[*]Want a matching built-in kitchen or house exterior? Find the two independent reskins under [b]Optional files[/b].[/*]
[*]Start through SMAPI and visit [b]Robin's[/b] 🪵💜[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[size=4][b]❓ Good to know[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Choose one furniture framework and keep that choice on an existing save. Their item IDs are different.[/*]
[*]Furniture Framework supports manual lamp toggles and colored lights. Content Patcher uses the base game's automatic lamp behavior; the lighting presentation can differ.[/*]
[*]The Legacy Placeable Appliances download keeps the separate cooking stove, refill sink and mini-fridge. The optional kitchen reskin applies to the fixed farmhouse fixtures.[/*]
[*]Mirrors are painted glass, not live reflections. The wall clock is ornamental. Display cupboards and decorative drawer fronts do not open into storage.[/*]
[*]Use one farmhouse retexture at a time if you install the optional house. Custom maps, multiplayer and switching frameworks on an existing save are not covered by this release's checks.[/*]
[*]The gallery uses actual game screenshots and labelled panels assembled in [b]Kitsuwick[/b]. The base-game farm and rooms are backdrops; the catalogue shows the furnishings and the three placeable appliances now in the legacy download.[/*]
[/list]
[b]💌 Sharing:[/b] Enjoy it in your game, screenshots and streams! Please don't reupload, sell or bundle the set, and ask me before sharing edits or reusing the art 🙏
